basic_info.description: Step inside this stunning home and feel like you've stepped into a luxurious oasis. Extensively rebuilt in 2020, this 4 bedroom, 4.5 bathroom home is the perfect blend of modern convenience and classic elegance. The open floor plan is perfect for entertaining, with a large kitchen island that features seating for six, custom cabinetry and top-of-the-line appliances. The backyard is turfed and accessible from the breakfast room, making it the ideal spot for outdoor gatherings and children's play area. The attention to detail in this home is truly remarkable. The Marvin Signature double-paned glass windows and doors, LED lighting, Lutron Caseta automation, and motorized Lutron blinds and drapes in the living room, primary suite & office are just a few of the high-end features that make this home stand out. The smart Ecobee thermostats, Cat6e security cameras, whole-house water filter, and a tankless natural gas water heater. The HVAC system features hydronic radiant heat with smart Ecobee thermostats. The finishes in the home are equally impressive.Two car garage with storage provides direct entrance to the well thought out mud and laundry room.
